This took a long time translating because cleaning the text and sfx were such a pain in the ass. The image quality is also not high quality since most of them is downloaded from Twitter or Pixiv. But overall, I'm satisfied with the result.

FYI, the artist has not uploaded any art for almost a year now and they doesn't seem to be active on Twitter. I hope we can see more of their art someday.
